# The Future Is Already Here

A 20-second electric-blue tech reel, rebuilt from the viral original: 3D cubes, a word tunnel, liquid chrome type, a FUTURE.EXE desktop, a countdown, glass objects and a chrome FUTURE hero, cut to 120 BPM. `example.html` is the finished reference — start from it.

The reference timing and beat map describe the demo. Adapt them to the user's
requested duration and content; do not force the reference duration or music.

## Source
A remake of a viral post by Douyin: https://www.douyin.com/video/7690393045783346918 (6,439 likes · 2,164 saves · 1,285 shares on Douyin (as of 2026-10-12)). The composition is
rebuilt in code from the published piece; the soundtrack is original.

## Reference files
Copy `example.html`, `assets/gsap.min.js`, `assets/three-addons.js`, `assets/unbounded-black-glyphs.js`, `assets/jetbrains-mono-OFL.txt`, `assets/jetbrains-mono-subset.ttf`, `assets/three.min.js.gz`, `assets/unbounded-OFL.txt`, `assets/unbounded-subset.ttf` into the composition, preserving the `assets/` path.
Copy the demo soundtrack only if selected under the Sound guidance below.
Font licenses travel with their fonts. Use these frozen local bytes; no runtime
script or font CDN is needed.

The gallery loads `assets/three.min.js`. The frozen reference package carries
the same Three.js bytes compressed as `assets/three.min.js.gz` to fit the
per-file budget. Before rendering, decompress it into the composition:
`gzip -dc "<reference-root>/assets/three.min.js.gz" > "<composition-root>/assets/three.min.js"`.
Both placeholders are the actual reference and composition directories in this
task. Keep the HTML script URL pointing to the decompressed `.js` file.

## Art direction
- Electric blue, black, white and chrome; heavy display type Unbounded Black with JetBrains Mono for the HUD (both SIL OFL, bundled).
- Three.js for the 3D layer (`#gl`) under a 2D overlay canvas (`#ui`). All scenes are readable code inside `example.html`.
- `assets/three-addons.js` holds the three.js add-ons the film needs (RoomEnvironment, FontLoader, TextGeometry), unbundled. `assets/unbounded-black-glyphs.js` holds Unbounded Black outlines for every 3D word: A–Z, a–z, 0–9 and common punctuation.
- The original is a 62s Chinese post; this reference is a 20s English highlight cut.

## Beat map (20s)
- 0–1.5 cubes 1→4→64 · 1.5–2.5 SIGNAL · 2.5–4.0 retina + 97.2% · 4.0–5.0 word tunnel WAKE UP · 5.0–6.0 THE FUTURE · 6.0–6.5 liquid chrome FUTURE
- 6.5–7.5 AL READY / HERE · 7.5–9.0 FUTURE.EXE desktop · 9.0–9.5 LOADING 99% · 9.5–11.0 3·2·1 · 11.0–13.0 PRISM / BOLT / PLANET / MIND
- 13.0–14.0 ring vortex · 14.0–14.5 checker grid · 14.5–18.5 chrome FUTURE hero · 18.5–20.0 glitch → END OF TRANSMISSION

## Adapting the template
- Change the copy in `CFG` at the top of `example.html`: `brand`, `headline`, `hero` (the chrome 3D word, scaled to fit when longer than FUTURE), `heroLine`, `date`, `signal`, `wake`, `awaken`, `tags`, `objects` and `endLine`.
- Keep hard cuts on the 120 BPM grid, the scene order in `EDIT` and the chrome hero. Scene code lives in the same file, grouped by scene.
- 3D words support Latin letters, digits and common punctuation; the bundled display font covers Latin only.

## How the reference is built
- One composition root with canvas layers. A single `render(t)` draws the
  whole frame from the master timeline time `t`; constants at the top hold copy,
  palette and timing so the film can be re-themed in one place.
- Every visible value is a pure function of `t` (eases, springs or keyframes
  evaluated from time). No state carries between frames.

## Preview and video export
Keep the stage edge to edge in both gallery and MP4 capture. Playback controls
are an overlay that stays transparent until hovered or focused; never reserve
stage space for them or include them in the poster. Inside an Open Design
project the motion source player fits the stage and owns the controls, so the
preview shell yields its own fit and controls there.

The GSAP master timeline is the only clock. Render every visible layer from
its current time in the per-frame loop: export seeks suppress timeline
callbacks. Schedule the next animation frame before drawing so one failed
frame cannot stop the loop. Backward seeks must reproduce identical frames.
Await bundled fonts before playback and signal preview-ready at a legible hero
frame. Preserve `window.__timelines` and the composition's timing attributes.
Avoid large canvas gradients and per-pixel noise: they make every captured
frame expensive and slow the MP4 export.

## Sound
`assets/soundtrack.mp3` is an original 20-second score made for this template
and timed to its beats; no audio from the source video is used.
The bundled track is demo material, not a requirement for generated films.
The user's current brief takes priority over this reference and its seed prompt,
including duration, music choice, genre, mood, voiceover and sound effects.
Follow the general motion-design audio guidance; this template does not disable
available audio tools or original audio synthesis.

- If the user requests a silent film, remove all audio. If they request only
  no background music, remove the music but retain any requested sound effects
  or voiceover. No voiceover does not mean no music.
- Use the user's supplied audio when requested. If they request different music,
  choose or create a suitable real local asset using the available audio tools,
  licensed sources or original synthesis. Do not silently substitute the demo
  track for an unmet request; briefly disclose any limitation.
- Without a specific music request, add appropriate audio when it benefits the
  film. Reuse the demo track only when it suits the actual story, mood and timing;
  it is an option, not the default for every adaptation.
- Fit the visuals and audio to the requested film duration, not to the demo's
  duration. For example, a 15-second brief stays 15 seconds even when the demo
  score is 20 seconds. Edit the selected track with a deliberate ending/fade;
  use the same edited local file in HTML and MP4. For a longer film, arrange or
  replace the track to cover the intended beats rather than leaving an accidental
  silent tail. Do not rely on an HTML-only loop or playbackRate for export.

For background music keep `id="soundtrack"`, `data-start="0"` and a numeric
`data-volume`; update `src` and `data-duration` to the actual edited asset and
film. Remove unused demo audio from the generated composition. Set the source's
`od-motion-audio` metadata to `required` when sound is intended, or `silent` for
an intentionally silent film, using the general motion-design delivery guidance.
Verify the ending and audio in both HTML playback and the exported MP4.

The `<audio>` element stays inside the composition root; the desktop exporter
mixes its local file into the MP4. Preview sound starts with the film; when the
browser blocks autoplay, the first click or key press turns it on, and Sound off
mutes it. Sound follows the master timeline, including pause and backward
seeks. Keep it silent during frame capture and in sandboxed gallery thumbnails.

# 动效设计师名片

从 `example.html` 开始改编。保留目录中的 `assets/Anton-400.ttf`、`assets/Anton-OFL.txt`、`assets/Caveat-400.ttf`、`assets/Caveat-OFL.txt`、`assets/gsap.min.js`、`assets/cover.jpg` 和 `references/sound.json`。原音轨 `assets/soundtrack.mp3` 由 runner 添加。

**Arc:** 弹跳 → 文字 → 动作词 → 缓动 → 跟随 → 预备动作 → 名片

| 场景（CFG.scenes id） | 时长 | 画面含义 | 构建方式 | 复用 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `spacing` | 1.9 s | 蓝球沿衰减弹跳路径运动，残影解释间距。 | 单画布，CFG.cues 驱动，绝对时间纯函数 | 保留动作机制，文字取 CFG |
| `type` | 1.85 s | I MAKE THINGS / MOVE 逐字错峰入场。 | 单画布，CFG.cues 驱动，绝对时间纯函数 | 保留动作机制，文字取 CFG |
| `actions` | 1.8 s | BOUNCE、STRETCH、SPIN、SNAP 快速切换。 | 单画布，CFG.cues 驱动，绝对时间纯函数 | 保留动作机制，文字取 CFG |
| `easing` | 2.9 s | 位置时间曲线由直线转为 S 形，方块演示运动间距。 | 单画布，CFG.cues 驱动，绝对时间纯函数 | 保留动作机制，文字取 CFG |
| `follow` | 2.55 s | 蓝色粒子头拖着尾迹绕行，点阵受其影响。 | 单画布，CFG.cues 驱动，绝对时间纯函数 | 保留动作机制，文字取 CFG |
| `anticipation` | 2.15 s | 环形刻度从零加载至百分之百，中心圆预备动作。 | 单画布，CFG.cues 驱动，绝对时间纯函数 | 保留动作机制，文字取 CFG |
| `hello` | 1.911333 s | MOTION DESIGNER / CLAUDE 与接洽项目短句收尾。 | 单画布，CFG.cues 驱动，绝对时间纯函数 | 保留动作机制，文字取 CFG |

## Adapting the template

- `spacing`：不含可换文案；新增项目另做一段，减少项目不能删掉蓝球的落地。 范围 1.9–2.8 秒，可延长；增加时间由持续弹跳填充。保留该段入场机制及尾部 `spacing-out` cue。
- `type`：headline 最多 20 字符，verb 最多 8 字符；超长先精简，不缩小到难以阅读。只展示一组主标题，多组时择最强一组。 范围 1.85–2.8 秒，可延长；增加时间由圆点与下划线的轻微摆动填充。保留该段入场机制及尾部 `type-out` cue。
- `actions`：保留四个动作词及其含义；项目增减时仍保留四种动作机制，不堆叠更多字卡。 范围 1.8–1.8 秒，锁定时长；增加时间由字卡旋转或拉伸填充。保留该段入场机制及尾部 `actions-out` cue。
- `easing`：保留直线转 S 曲线与单个运动方块；更多数据只择一组，不压缩坐标图。 范围 2.9–4.3 秒，可延长；增加时间由方块循环演示填充。保留该段入场机制及尾部 `easing-out` cue。
- `follow`：保留一个主粒子与残影；多个主体时择一个，不能变成静止装饰。 范围 2.55–3.8 秒，可延长；增加时间由粒子持续运动填充。保留该段入场机制及尾部 `follow-out` cue。
- `anticipation`：保留中心圆、百分比与环形加载；只用一个百分比指标，不增加环数。 范围 2.15–3.2 秒，可延长；增加时间由圆点呼吸和刻度环旋转填充。保留该段入场机制及尾部 `anticipation-out` cue。
- `hello`：name 最多 12 字符，role 最多 22 字符，availability 最多 28 字符；超长精简。多人时择一位主角，不能横排多人名片。 范围 1.911333–3 秒，可延长；增加时间由圆点的轻微压缩、位移与文字呼吸填充。保留该段入场机制及尾部 `hello-out` cue。

总时长改变时优先由 easing、follow、hello 吸收，其次 spacing、type、anticipation；actions 的快速字卡固定。重新求和 CFG.duration，场景开始时间自动累加。
Chinese / CJK：heading 使用 Anton 400，body 使用 Caveat 400–700；均后接同字重 Noto Sans SC。繁体改 Noto Sans TC。交付前用真实中英文混排及标点捕获一帧检查缺字；没有中文字体时明确告知。
Brand-bound: hello 的 CLAUDE 姓名、职业与接洽短句必须按用户身份改写；type 的自我宣言也按用户主张在同一形式中重写，不能沿用原设计师身份。

## Sound

The demo track is the reference film's own soundtrack.
The bundled track is demo material, not a requirement for generated films.
The user's current brief takes priority over this reference and its seed prompt,
including duration, music choice, genre, mood, voiceover and sound effects.
Follow the general motion-design audio guidance; this template does not disable
available audio tools or original audio synthesis.

- If the user requests a silent film, remove all audio. If they request only
  no background music, remove the music but retain any requested sound effects
  or voiceover. No voiceover does not mean no music.
- Use the user's supplied audio when requested. If they request different music,

  licensed sources or original synthesis. Do not silently substitute the demo
  track for an unmet request; briefly disclose any limitation.
- Without a specific music request, add appropriate audio when it benefits the
  film. Reuse the demo track only when it suits the actual story, mood and timing;
  it is an option, not the default for every adaptation.
- Fit the visuals and audio to the requested film duration, not to the demo's
  duration. For example, a 15-second brief stays 15 seconds even when the demo
  score is 20 seconds. Edit the selected track with a deliberate ending/fade;
  use the same edited local file in HTML and MP4. For a longer film, arrange or
  replace the track to cover the intended beats rather than leaving an accidental
  silent tail. Do not rely on an HTML-only loop or playbackRate for export.

For background music keep `id="soundtrack"`, `data-start="0"` and a numeric
`data-volume`; update `src` and `data-duration` to the actual edited asset and
film. Remove unused demo audio from the generated composition. Set the source's
`od-motion-audio` metadata to `required` when sound is intended, or `silent` for
an intentionally silent film, using the general motion-design delivery guidance.
Verify the ending and audio in both HTML playback and the exported MP4.

The `<audio>` element stays inside the composition root; the desktop exporter
mixes its local file into the MP4. Preview sound starts with the film; when the
browser blocks autoplay, the first click or key press turns it on, and Sound off
mutes it. Sound follows the master timeline, including pause and backward
seeks. Keep it silent during frame capture and in sandboxed gallery thumbnails.
When the film length changes, refit or replace the track using references/sound.json (bpm, sections).
To refit, cut the track at the original scene boundaries, time-stretch each piece to its new scene length with ffmpeg atempo (keep each factor within 0.8–1.25; beyond that, trim or loop that piece instead), join the pieces with 40 ms crossfades, fade in 0.15 s and out over the last second, and replace assets/soundtrack.mp3 with the result at exactly CFG.duration.

@himanshutwtxs：https://x.com/himanshutwtxs/status/2103495232637882858。仅作署名，不访问原链接。

name: mind-clarity-journey
description: 清晰心智主题的黑红剪影动效模板。

以 `example.html` 为影片起点；保留单 canvas 与 GSAP 主时钟，按 `CFG` 调整内容。

**Arc:** 清晰 → 成长 → 专注 → 想法 → 出发

| 场景（CFG.scenes id） | 时长 | 画面与含义 | 实现 | 复用 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `clarity` | 2.25 s | 头脑敞开，太阳升起再缩为水滴 | canvas 路径与射线，`sun-rise`、`mind-reveal`、`sun-sink` | 三个开场文字变量；保留升起与内收 |
| `growth` | 2.083333 s | 手臂举壶，头顶生出红色枝叶 | `water-pour`、`plant-grow`、`water-stop`；宽高联动生长、顶叶倾斜与循环水滴 | 无产品列表；保留浇灌因果 |
| `focus` | 2.166667 s | 手中火柴点燃，出现专注燃料文案 | `match-light`、`focus-reveal`、`fuel-reveal`；点火轮廓依次变形，随后轻微弯曲 | `focusLine`、`fuelLine` |
| `ideas` | 2.458333 s | 几何想法升起并落入头脑 | `ideas-rise`、`ideas-fall`；漂浮、收窄与分阶段碎裂 | 保留抽象形状的视觉节奏 |
| `doorway` | 1.397767 s | 人走向打开的红色门 | `door-open`、`journey-end`；门的透视与步态 | `portalArt` 为可替换图像 |

## 文件
复制 `example.html`、`assets/gsap.min.js`、`assets/arimo-400.ttf`、`assets/arimo-700.ttf`、`assets/arimo-OFL.txt`、`assets/portal-art.png`、`references/sound.json`，保持相对路径。封面为 `assets/cover.jpg`。`assets/soundtrack.mp3` 由运行器添加。所有字体和脚本均本地加载。

## Adapting the template
- `clarity`：可改 `mindLine`（12 字符）、`growthLine`（10）、`clarityLine`（13）；超长先精简或改写，不能缩小到难读。保留太阳升起、文字分行和缩为水滴的过程。可延长到 2.25–3.2 s，太阳呼吸和射线持续微动，离场由 `sun-sink` 与 `clarity-cut` 倒推。此场不是产品清单；多条信息只选最重要一句，少条信息保持三行可读语义。
- `growth`：可按主题改造正在生长的图形，保留水滴落下与枝叶生长的因果关系。范围 2.083333–3.1 s，延长时水滴持续到离场前 0.5 秒，成熟叶片和手臂仅微动。无文字长度限制；增加叶片最多保留五个主视觉元素，少于五个时围绕主茎平衡分布。
- `focus`：`focusLine`、`fuelLine` 各最多 12 字符，超长先精简。保留短暂转腕、回撤与回卷→分叉→窄长→稳定的点火形变，不改为静态图。范围 2.166667–3.2 s，延长时稳定火苗仅轻微弯曲，手在点燃姿态保持；不要添加整团火焰的周期缩放。多条文案选最核心一组，少条保留足够留白。
- `ideas`：可替换抽象符号，保留从头脑涌出、漂浮、落回的过程。范围 2.458333–3.6 s，扩展时持续旋转和升降。无文字；更多元素只保留最强的十个，较少元素围绕中央圆形分布。离场始终读取 `ideas-fall`、`ideas-cut`，在结束前 0.9 秒开始分阶段收窄与碎裂。
- `doorway`：可替换 `portalArt`，保留黑色门扇、景象揭示与走向门的人。范围 1.397767–2.1 s，延长时人物继续步行，不能停在最终姿势。无文案；只保留一个目的地，多个目的地选择最重要的一个。不能用静态人物替代步态。

总时长变化先由 `growth`、`ideas` 吸收，其次 `focus`、`clarity`，最后 `doorway`；没有绝对锁定场景，但不得低于各自 minDur。更新 CFG.duration 与所有场景之和，开始时间自动累计。离场 cue 使用 from: "end"。

Chinese / CJK：标题为 Arimo 700，正文为 Arimo 400，分别经 `--od-font-heading` 与 `--od-font-body` 回退到同字重 Noto Sans SC，再到系统中文字体；繁体中文改用 Noto Sans TC。交付改编前必须用真实中英混排和标点渲染一帧，检查缺字、方框与字体跳变。机器无中文字体时明确告知用户；只有用户指定时才增加专用中文字体。

Brand-bound: none

content:
# Opus Motion Design Lab

从 `example.html` 开始制作影片。它是一段 15.125 秒的浏览器工作台式动效实验室：上方是演示舞台，中间的像素向导指向当前控制项，下方是始终可见的六格代码面板。

**Arc:** spacing → typography → motion blur → easing → follow-through → anticipation → final delivery

| Scene (`CFG.scenes` id) | Dur | Summary | Build | Reuse |
|-|-|-|-|-|
| `spacing` | 1.967 s | 蓝球沿弧线弹跳，残影解释动作间距 | canvas 弹道与轮廓残影；`ball-release` 触发起跳 | 可替换 `accent`；保留带残影的弹跳教学机制 |
| `typography` | 1.800 s | 巨型「I MAKE THINGS / MOVE.」错落组装 | canvas 活字逐字进入；`words-stack` 与 `type-out` 控制进退场 | 可替换 `heroCopy`；保留上下两级尺度和蓝色句点 |
| `motion-blur` | 1.800 s | 黑底依次演示 STRETCH、SPIN、SNAP | canvas 拉伸残影、旋转和挤压；`stretch-hit` 触发第一击 | 可换主色；三个动作词和连续变形是签名 |
| `easing` | 2.900 s | 线性图变成 ease-in-out，方块沿轨道推进 | canvas 曲线、游标与卡片列；`linear-mark` 标记比较 | 可换双色；保留图表与实体方块的对应关系 |
| `follow-through` | 2.733 s | 蓝色主体在点阵中绕行并拖出红蓝尾迹 | canvas 粒子链按时间采样；`trail-turn` 标记转弯 | 可换双色；保留延迟尾迹与点阵空间 |
| `anticipation` | 1.967 s | 环形仪表从 0% 蓄力到 100% | canvas 同心圆、刻度与充能弧；`gauge-fill` 开始充能 | 可换主色；保留由跟随轨迹变成仪表的观感 |
| `final-delivery` | 1.958 s | 「MOTION DESIGNER / CLAUDE.」锁定收尾 | canvas 两级标题与蓝色句点；`name-build` 触发排版 | 可替换 `designerRole`、`designerName`；保留上下堆叠和句点 |

## Adapting the template

- `spacing`：可改主色和注释，但弹跳、残影与基线必须保留。范围 1.5–3.0 秒，增加时由循环弹跳和页面轻微呼吸填充。此场景不显示可替换长文案；若需要更多示例球，只保留一个主球，其余作为更淡的轨迹样本。
- `typography`：可改 `heroCopy`，上限 20 个字符；超出时先缩短文案，不要把主标题缩到失去冲击力。范围 1.6–3.0 秒，额外时间由逐字微漂和句点呼吸填充。单词多于四个时仍分两行，并把最强动词独占第二行；更少时保持第二行的单词更大。
- `motion-blur`：可改色彩，不建议改 STRETCH / SPIN / SNAP 三词及其顺序，因为三种变形组成教学签名。范围 1.5–2.5 秒，额外时间按相同顺序循环轻量残影；若增减示例，优先保留三项，不新开第二行。
- `easing`：可改曲线说明与双色，但必须保留“曲线 + 运动方块”的对应展示。范围 2.5–4.2 秒，额外时间由游标沿曲线循环和方块轮替填充。说明文案宜不超过 18 个字符；更长时缩短说明。示例多于八个时加快轮替，不增加第二排。
- `follow-through`：可改粒子颜色，主体领先、尾部延迟的关系必须保留。范围 2.4–4.0 秒，额外时间由轨迹继续绕行填充。没有长文案；若增加粒子数量，应延长尾部密度而不是增加第二条主轨迹。
- `anticipation`：可改主色和百分比样式，但必须保留蓄力圆环从低值到 100% 的动作。范围 1.7–3.0 秒，额外时间由中心呼吸和刻度轮转填充。若需要多个指标，只展示最重要的一个，不把环拆成多个小仪表。
- `final-delivery`：可改 `designerRole`（上限 24 字符）和 `designerName`（上限 16 字符）；超出时先精简，不得把姓名缩到低于主标题的视觉级别。范围 1.7–3.0 秒，额外时间由蓝色句点呼吸和页面微漂填充。只有一个署名；若用户提供多个名字，合并为团队名。

改变总时长时，优先让 `easing`、`follow-through` 和 `anticipation` 吸收时长，其次是 `spacing`；`motion-blur` 尽量维持原始节拍。所有离场与转场都读取 `from: "end"` 的 cue，不要手写场景尾部时间。

页眉两张品牌卡分别由 `anthropicLogo`、`claudeCodeLogo` 提供，面板右下的交付预览由 `previewStrip` 提供；替换时保持原始宽高比和当前卡片尺寸，不要把整张页面截图放进这些槽位。

非拉丁文案：标题使用已打包的 Barlow Condensed，正文使用已打包的 Barlow；两者的简体中文后备均为 Noto Sans SC，并使用与拉丁字面匹配的字重。繁体中文改用 Noto Sans TC。交付前要用用户的真实文案（包括标点和中英混排）渲染一帧，确认没有字形回退错位或方框；如果执行环境完全没有 Chinese/CJK 字体，应明确告知用户，而不是直接交付。

## Sound
`assets/soundtrack.mp3` is the reference film's own soundtrack.
The bundled track is demo material, not a requirement for generated films.
The user's current brief takes priority over this reference and its seed prompt,
including duration, music choice, genre, mood, voiceover and sound effects.
Follow the general motion-design audio guidance; this template does not disable
available audio tools or original audio synthesis.

- If the user requests a silent film, remove all audio. If they request only
  no background music, remove the music but retain any requested sound effects
  or voiceover. No voiceover does not mean no music.
- Use the user's supplied audio when requested. If they request different music,
  choose or create a suitable real local asset using the available audio tools,
  licensed sources or original synthesis. Do not silently substitute the demo
  track for an unmet request; briefly disclose any limitation.
- Without a specific music request, add appropriate audio when it benefits the
  film. Reuse the demo track only when it suits the actual story, mood and timing;
  it is an option, not the default for every adaptation.
- Fit the visuals and audio to the requested film duration, not to the demo's
  duration. When the film length changes, refit or replace the track using
  references/sound.json (bpm, sections). Edit the selected track with a
  deliberate ending/fade; use the same edited local file in HTML and MP4.

For background music keep `id="soundtrack"`, `data-start="0"` and a numeric
`data-volume`; update `src` and `data-duration` to the actual edited asset and
film. Remove unused demo audio from the generated composition. The `<audio>`
element stays inside the composition root, and sound follows the master timeline.

## Source

参考影片由 [@beamnxw](https://x.com/beamnxw/status/2112180280110776797) 发布；本模板仅重建其画面结构、文字、节奏与动效机制。

# Product Promo

A 15-second product promo rebuilt from the viral original with a fictional brand: a halftone mascot asks "Got something to sell?", product cards pop onto blue, a phone store fills in, a checkout board is stamped "Handled." and the wordmark closes it. `example.html` is the finished reference — start from it.

The reference timing and beat map describe the demo. Adapt them to the user's
requested duration and content; do not force the reference duration or music.

## Source
A remake of a viral post by @achxvi: https://x.com/achxvi/status/2103918792845963545 (1.14M views · 9.1K likes · 8.2K bookmarks on X (as of 2026-10-13)). The composition is
rebuilt in code from the published piece; the soundtrack is original. The original promotes a real company; this remake uses the fictional brand Pennyflow.

## Reference files
Copy `example.html`, `assets/fraunces-OFL.txt`, `assets/fraunces-bold.ttf`, `assets/gsap.min.js`, `assets/instrument-serif-OFL.txt`, `assets/instrument-serif-italic.ttf`, `assets/inter-OFL.txt`, `assets/inter-regular.ttf`, `assets/inter-semibold.ttf`, `assets/jetbrains-mono-OFL.txt`, `assets/jetbrains-mono-regular.ttf` into the composition, preserving the `assets/` path.
Copy the demo soundtrack only if selected under the Sound guidance below.
Font licenses travel with their fonts. Use these frozen local bytes; no runtime
script or font CDN is needed.

## Art direction
- White `#FFFFFF`, blue `#1F70F3`, ink `#111111`, a light board `#FBFBFB` and near-black `#060606`.
- Fonts (SIL OFL, bundled): Inter Regular and SemiBold for headlines and UI, Fraunces Bold for the wordmark, Instrument Serif Italic for the accent words, JetBrains Mono for labels and the HUD.
- The mascot is a girl with two buns, a rounded bob, fringe locks and a hair clip; she nods and hops on the beat, blinks, follows what appears, and hops with a squash on each reveal.
- The mascot and the product objects are drawn in grey at quarter resolution and ordered-dithered into a halftone, one `halftone()` pass per layer.
- HUD: the chapter label top left, the brand and a 60 fps timecode top right; hidden on the end card.

## Beat map (15s)
- 0–2.45s HOOK: the mascot slides in and whispers "psst…"; "Got something / to sell?" with a blue underline; the question's dot swells into blue.
- 2.45–4.45s ANYTHING: the mascot rises; course, ebook and app cards pop in one by one.
- 4.45–6.95s STORE: a whip to white; "Pennyflow turns it into / a store / in minutes."; a phone store fills in (address, LIVE, avatar, products); the cursor clicks Get it now.
- 6.95–11.2s HANDLED: the camera pulls out of the express-pay button onto a checkout bento: the card number is typed, $9 / month, the workbook upsell, VAT, payouts counting up, Paid, check badges and the "Handled." stamp.
- 11.2–13.3s FLOW: on black, "You create." / "We handle the", the mascot winking and grinning.
- 13.3–15s END: a dithered wipe; "flow." becomes the wordmark's tail, the letters drop in, the head pops up behind it; tagline, Start selling and the footer.

## Character and close
- `SPEECH` lists the visual mouth gestures' start, length and openness; `mouth(t)` opens the mouth and nods the head alongside the copy. These are visual gestures only: the soundtrack is background music, with no voice or simulated speech.
- At the close, "flow." springs out of "We handle the", travels to centre stage and pops into the wordmark's tail while the other letters drop in; the head peeks out from behind the wordmark, hops up and winks.

## Adapting the template
- Swap `CFG.brand`, `CFG.domain`, `CFG.store`, the card, product and checkout copy, prices and palette; keep the six chapters on their timing, and retime `SPEECH` to new lines.

## How the reference is built
- One composition root with canvas layers. A single `render(t)` draws the
  whole frame from the master timeline time `t`; constants at the top hold copy,
  palette and timing so the film can be re-themed in one place.
- Every visible value is a pure function of `t` (eases, springs or keyframes
  evaluated from time). No state carries between frames.

## Preview and video export
Keep the stage edge to edge in both gallery and MP4 capture. Playback controls
are an overlay that stays transparent until hovered or focused; never reserve
stage space for them or include them in the poster. Inside an Open Design
project the motion source player fits the stage and owns the controls, so the
preview shell yields its own fit and controls there.

The GSAP master timeline is the only clock. Render every visible layer from
its current time in the per-frame loop: export seeks suppress timeline
callbacks. Schedule the next animation frame before drawing so one failed
frame cannot stop the loop. Backward seeks must reproduce identical frames.
Await bundled fonts before playback and signal preview-ready at a legible hero
frame. Preserve `window.__timelines` and the composition's timing attributes.
Avoid large canvas gradients and per-pixel noise: they make every captured
frame expensive and slow the MP4 export.

## Sound
`assets/soundtrack.mp3` is an original 15-second background music track made
for this template and timed to its beats, with no voice or simulated speech;
no audio from the source video is used.
The percussion is a quiet, sparse pulse beneath the melody, with no hi-hat,
clap pattern or extra kick impacts on transitions. This describes the demo, not
a restriction on the user's requested audio.
The bundled track is demo material, not a requirement for generated films.
The user's current brief takes priority over this reference and its seed prompt,
including duration, music choice, genre, mood, voiceover and sound effects.
Follow the general motion-design audio guidance; this template does not disable
available audio tools or original audio synthesis.

- If the user requests a silent film, remove all audio. If they request only
  no background music, remove the music but retain any requested sound effects
  or voiceover. No voiceover does not mean no music.
- Use the user's supplied audio when requested. If they request different music,
  choose or create a suitable real local asset using the available audio tools,
  licensed sources or original synthesis. Do not silently substitute the demo
  track for an unmet request; briefly disclose any limitation.
- Without a specific music request, add appropriate audio when it benefits the
  film. Reuse the demo track only when it suits the actual story, mood and timing;
  it is an option, not the default for every adaptation.
- Fit the visuals and audio to the requested film duration, not to the demo's
  duration. For example, a 15-second brief stays 15 seconds even when the demo
  score is 20 seconds. Edit the selected track with a deliberate ending/fade;
  use the same edited local file in HTML and MP4. For a longer film, arrange or

---
name: prompt-motion-gallery
description: Prompt Motion 网页作品浏览与形态变换演示。
---

从 `example.html` 开始制作；这是可寻址、单 Canvas、GSAP 主时钟驱动的完整影片。

**Arc:** 作品浏览 → 播放器形变 → 返回 → 图片打印演示 → 返回首页。

| 场景（CFG.scenes id） | 时长 | 画面与信息 | 构建方式 | 复用方式 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| gallery | 4.70 | 页面标题、订阅卡与四列作品墙上下浏览 | Canvas 重建网页；gallery-open 弹窗进入 | brand、headline、独立图片变量 |
| player | 4.50 | 按钮→加载→勾选→音乐播放器→音量条 | player-loader、player-check、player-island、player-expand、player-play、player-scrub、player-volume；实测过冲回落，文字分层去模糊显现 | album 与右侧截图可替换；保持同一黑形体 |
| browse | 1.20 | 关闭演示，回到作品墙，再打开图片演示 | player-out 退出；photo-enter 进入 | 保留鼠标驱动的浏览节奏 |
| photo | 4.05 | develop.→圆点→按钮→光圈→门洞照片→九宫格 | photo-dot、photo-pill、photo-label、photo-iris、photo-open、photo-grid；photo-out 退出 | wordmark、door 与照片变量 |
| close | 0.739333 | 弹窗收回，作品墙继续播放 | photo-out 尾部过渡；作品缩略图循环 | brand、headline 与作品素材 |

## 素材与结构

`CFG.duration` 是总长唯一来源，场景起点由 `CFG.scenes` 累加，`CFG.cues` 的尾部事件使用 `from: "end"`。时间函数没有跨帧状态。预览入口为 `window.__odRenderAt(t)`；播放条控制 `window.__timelines.main`。

将 `example.html`、`references/sound.json` 及下面列出的本地资源一起复制，保留路径。所有图片都有同名的 CFG 图片变量；文字输入为 `brand`（24 字符）、`headline`（110 字符）、`wordmark`（8 字符）。复杂作品缩略演示采用独立原图截图加重绘运动；需要更换品牌时连同嵌入文案的截图一起换。

`player-expand` 位于 player 场景内 1.591667 秒。岛形到卡片的大小、封面位置与过冲使用参考逐帧测量的相对时间关键点；标题、副标题、进度和播放控件分别显现，不能把卡片直接设成最终尺寸。`player-play` 之后沿用原来的拖拽和音量演示。

提示词滚动素材：`ui-player-scroll.png` 和 `ui-photo-code.png` 是独立右栏拼接长图，`PROMPT_FLOW` 保存所属场景内的取样位移，绘制时在右栏裁切。换成长提示词时同步重做长图和位移记录；保留固定关闭按钮与底部箭头，不把这些控件拼进滚动图。播放器长图从场景内 2.05 秒开始滚动，沿用既有长图与后续取样点；滚动条随内容位移。其余 ui 图片仍是 413×913 的独立栏截图。

## Adapting the template

- `gallery`：可换网站名、介绍、缩略作品和作者头像，保留四列瀑布流及先向下再回顶的浏览动作。范围 4.70–6.50 秒，额外时间由缩略图缩放、星芒旋转和播放器进度运动填充。brand 上限 24，headline 上限 110，超过上限先精简文字，不缩小字号。作品更多时继续向下排，较少时选最强作品重复排列以保持密度。
- `player`：可换封面、应用与曲目信息、右侧提示词截图，保留同一个黑色圆角形体连续变换。范围 4.50–6.50 秒；新增时间放在循环音量调整阶段，圆环、波形和进度条继续运动。本演示只显示一首曲目，更多项目只选一首代表作。截图文字需由新产品内容重做，trackTitle 最长 20、trackByline 最长 24、generateLabel 最长 12；超过时先缩短文案，不缩小字号。
- `browse`：可换所选作品，保留返回再点击另一作品的交互连接。范围 1.20–2.00 秒，作品缩略图持续运动。文字沿用 gallery 上限；更多作品留在墙中，主片只打开两项。
- `photo`：可换 wordmark、照片和右侧提示词截图，保留字标收缩、黑色按钮、光圈打开与照片展开这一机制。范围 4.05–6.00 秒，额外时间放在九宫格，照片组轻微呼吸缩放。actionLabel 最长 12 字符，wordmark 最长 8 字符，过长则用短名；九张照片不足时重复裁切，超过九张时选九张最有辨识度的。图片按参考裁切比例使用，避免把低分辨率原图放大超过 1.5 倍。
- `close`：可换作品墙内容，保留弹窗缩回与首页结束。范围 0.739333–1.50 秒，墙中各预览持续运动；文字限制和项目数量处理同 gallery。

改总长时优先增加 player、photo，再增加 gallery；browse、close 最后调整。没有硬锁定场景，所有场景均以绝对场景内秒数进场，离场以尾部 cue 驱动。不要整体缩放内部动画速度。

Chinese（中文）处理：`--od-font-heading` 使用本地 Geist，`--od-font-body` 使用本地 Inter，均以相同字重回退到 Noto Sans SC，再回退到苹方等系统中文字体。繁体中文换为 Noto Sans TC。交付前用真实中英混排与标点渲染一帧，检查方框与异常回退；机器完全没有中文字体时必须告知使用者。仅在用户指定时增加特定中文字体。

Brand-bound: gallery、browse、close 的 Prompt Motion、Claude 与作者作品内容，player 的曲目与提示词，photo 的 develop. 和照片素材：换品牌时全部改写或替换成用户内容，保持相同布局与形变机制；没有新演示素材时删去对应弹窗并把时间交给 gallery。

## Sound
The demo track is the reference film's own soundtrack.
The bundled track is demo material, not a requirement for generated films.
The user's current brief takes priority over this reference and its seed prompt,
including duration, music choice, genre, mood, voiceover and sound effects.
Follow the general motion-design audio guidance; this template does not disable
available audio tools or original audio synthesis.

- If the user requests a silent film, remove all audio. If they request only
  no background music, remove the music but retain any requested sound effects
  or voiceover. No voiceover does not mean no music.
- Use the user's supplied audio when requested. If they request different music,
  choose or create a suitable real local asset using the available audio tools,
  licensed sources or original synthesis. Do not silently substitute the demo
  track for an unmet request; briefly disclose any limitation.
- Without a specific music request, add appropriate audio when it benefits the
  film. Reuse the demo track only when it suits the actual story, mood and timing;
  it is an option, not the default for every adaptation.
- Fit the visuals and audio to the requested film duration, not to the demo's
  duration. For example, a 15-second brief stays 15 seconds even when the demo
  score is 20 seconds. Edit the selected track with a deliberate ending/fade;
  use the same edited local file in HTML and MP4. For a longer film, arrange or
  replace the track to cover the intended beats rather than leaving an accidental
  silent tail. Do not rely on an HTML-only loop or playbackRate for export.

For background music keep `id="soundtrack"`, `data-start="0"` and a numeric
`data-volume`; update `src` and `data-duration` to the actual edited asset and
film. Remove unused demo audio from the generated composition. Set the source's
`od-motion-audio` metadata to `required` when sound is intended, or `silent` for
an intentionally silent film, using the general motion-design delivery guidance.
Verify the ending and audio in both HTML playback and the exported MP4.

The `<audio>` element stays inside the composition root; the desktop exporter
mixes its local file into the MP4. Preview sound starts with the film; when the
browser blocks autoplay, the first click or key press turns it on, and Sound off
mutes it. Sound follows the master timeline, including pause and backward
seeks. Keep it silent during frame capture and in sandboxed gallery thumbnails.

When the film length changes, refit or replace the track using references/sound.json (bpm, sections).
To refit, cut the track at the original scene boundaries, time-stretch each piece to its new scene length with ffmpeg atempo (keep each factor within 0.8–1.25; beyond that, trim or loop that piece instead), join the pieces with 40 ms crossfades, fade in 0.15 s and out over the last second, and replace assets/soundtrack.mp3 with the result at exactly CFG.duration.

## 来源

参考作者 @0xMovez：https://x.com/0xMovez/status/2108170313557016623 。没有访问来源链接；所有视觉分析、裁切与测量来自本地 reference.mp4。页面内的作品作者署名沿用参考截图。

## Adapting the template
`terms` 是逐行词语序列，默认共 28 行；每个词语最多 29 个拉丁字符或约 18 个汉字。总槽上限 500 字符。超过限制时先缩短文字，保持字号可读；不把全部新项目挤进同一场景。对常规改稿，重新编排该词的输入事件和对应色带目标；不要把默认色带误解为能自动理解任何新语义的模型。

- `tomato`：可替换与“番茄与藤蔓”对应的词语及配色，保留先输入、后重排的动作。范围 4.583333–6.874999，未锁定。新增时间放在完成输入后的停留，插入点继续闪动，色带边界继续轻缓往返；原速演示严格使用实测轨迹。该场景每行最多 27 个拉丁字符或约 13 个汉字，长文先改短。项目减少时省去该行输入，项目增加时复制一组输入与重排，不叠加更多文字。

The bundled track is demo material, not a requirement for generated films.
The user's current brief takes priority over this reference and its seed prompt,
including duration, music choice, genre, mood, voiceover and sound effects.
Follow the general motion-design audio guidance; this template does not disable
available audio tools or original audio synthesis.

- If the user requests a silent film, remove all audio. If they request only
  no background music, remove the music but retain any requested sound effects
  or voiceover. No voiceover does not mean no music.
- Use the user's supplied audio when requested. If they request different music,
  choose or create a suitable real local asset using the available audio tools,
  licensed sources or original synthesis. Do not silently substitute the demo
  track for an unmet request; briefly disclose any limitation.
- Without a specific music request, add appropriate audio when it benefits the
  film. Reuse the demo track only when it suits the actual story, mood and timing;
  it is an option, not the default for every adaptation.
- Fit the visuals and audio to the requested film duration, not to the demo's
  duration. For example, a 15-second brief stays 15 seconds even when the demo
  score is 20 seconds. Edit the selected track with a deliberate ending/fade;
  use the same edited local file in HTML and MP4. For a longer film, arrange or
  replace the track to cover the intended beats rather than leaving an accidental
  silent tail. Do not rely on an HTML-only loop or playbackRate for export.

`data-volume`; update `src` and `data-duration` to the actual edited asset and
film. Remove unused demo audio from the generated composition. Set the source's
`od-motion-audio` metadata to `required` when sound is intended, or `silent` for
an intentionally silent film, using the general motion-design delivery guidance.

mixes its local file into the MP4. Preview sound starts with the film; when the
browser blocks autoplay, the first click or key press turns it on, and Sound off
mutes it. Sound follows the master timeline, including pause and backward
seeks. Keep it silent during frame capture and in sandboxed gallery thumbnails.

When the film length changes, refit or replace the track using references/sound.json (bpm, sections).
To refit, cut the track at the original scene boundaries, time-stretch each piece to its new scene length with ffmpeg atempo (keep each factor within 0.8–1.25; beyond that, trim or loop that piece instead), join the pieces with 40 ms crossfades, fade in 0.15 s and out over the last second, and replace assets/soundtrack.mp3 with the result at exactly CFG.duration.

# Motion Designer Showreel

A 15-second motion designer showreel at 128 BPM, rebuilt from the viral original: an Open Design mark opener, a stretching wordmark, six easing curves, a morphing shape, a truchet field, a 3D point cloud, kinetic type and an end card. `example.html` is the finished reference — start from it.

The reference timing and beat map describe the demo. Adapt them to the user's
requested duration and content; do not force the reference duration or music.

## Source
A remake of a viral post by @stephanlivera: https://x.com/stephanlivera/status/2103315922098470926 (2.25M views · 17K likes · 13K bookmarks on X (as of 2026-10-05)). The composition is
rebuilt in code from the published piece; the soundtrack is original.

## Reference files
Copy `example.html`, `assets/archivo-OFL.txt`, `assets/archivo-condensed-black.ttf`, `assets/archivo-expanded-black.ttf`, `assets/archivo-extrabold.ttf`, `assets/gsap.min.js`, `assets/instrument-serif-OFL.txt`, `assets/instrument-serif-italic.ttf`, `assets/jetbrains-mono-OFL.txt`, `assets/jetbrains-mono-bold.ttf`, `assets/jetbrains-mono-medium.ttf` into the composition, preserving the `assets/` path.
Copy the demo soundtrack only if selected under the Sound guidance below.
Font licenses travel with their fonts. Use these frozen local bytes; no runtime
script or font CDN is needed.

## Art direction
- Hard colour cuts in the Open Design palette: near-black `#202020`, Open Design green `#87EA5C`, paper `#FAFAFA`, deep green `#007106` and pale green `#D0FFB5`; ink `#26251E`.
- Fonts (SIL OFL, bundled): Archivo Expanded Black and Condensed Black for display type, Archivo ExtraBold, Instrument Serif Italic for the role line, JetBrains Mono for the HUD.
- HUD on every frame: corner marks, brand and "MOTION REEL — 2026", chapter label, timecode, 60 FPS, 128 BPM with four beat squares, BAR n/8 and a progress line.

## Beat map (15s)
- 0–2.0s IDENTITY: rays burst from a dot and spin, the Open Design mark draws on and fills with a flash, orbiting type, a paper circle wipe.
- 2.0–3.5s the wordmark slides in on two lines, squeezes and settles; "motion designer" in serif italic.
- 3.5–5.5s EASING: "Six ways to get from A to B." — linear, ease-in-out, expo-out, back-out, elastic, bounce.
- 5.5–7.45s MORPHING: circle → triangle → star → squircle with green echoes and twelve satellites.
- 7.45–9.75s SYSTEMS: a paper tile splits into a truchet field crossed by a green wave.
- 9.75–11.2s DEPTH: a point plane folds into a lantern, then a torus.
- 11.2–13.1s KINETIC TYPE: EASE / IN. / EASE / OUT. / NEVER / LINEAR.
- 13.1–15s END: a white ring rolls out, the spinning Open Design mark with confetti settles beside the stacked wordmark, role line and footer.

## Adapting the template
- Swap `CFG.brand`, `CFG.role`, footer copy and palette to the brief; keep the seven chapters on the 128 BPM grid.

## How the reference is built
- One composition root with canvas layers. A single `render(t)` draws the
  whole frame from the master timeline time `t`; constants at the top hold copy,
  palette and timing so the film can be re-themed in one place.
- Every visible value is a pure function of `t` (eases, springs or keyframes
  evaluated from time). No state carries between frames.

## Preview and video export
Keep the stage edge to edge in both gallery and MP4 capture. Playback controls
are an overlay that stays transparent until hovered or focused; never reserve
stage space for them or include them in the poster. Inside an Open Design
project the motion source player fits the stage and owns the controls, so the
preview shell yields its own fit and controls there.

The GSAP master timeline is the only clock. Render every visible layer from
its current time in the per-frame loop: export seeks suppress timeline
callbacks. Schedule the next animation frame before drawing so one failed
frame cannot stop the loop. Backward seeks must reproduce identical frames.
Await bundled fonts before playback and signal preview-ready at a legible hero
frame. Preserve `window.__timelines` and the composition's timing attributes.
Avoid large canvas gradients and per-pixel noise: they make every captured
frame expensive and slow the MP4 export.

## Sound
`assets/soundtrack.mp3` is an original 15-second score made for this template
and timed to its beats; no audio from the source video is used.
The bundled track is demo material, not a requirement for generated films.
The user's current brief takes priority over this reference and its seed prompt,
including duration, music choice, genre, mood, voiceover and sound effects.
Follow the general motion-design audio guidance; this template does not disable
available audio tools or original audio synthesis.

- If the user requests a silent film, remove all audio. If they request only
  no background music, remove the music but retain any requested sound effects

- Use the user's supplied audio when requested. If they request different music,

  track for an unmet request; briefly disclose any limitation.
- Without a specific music request, add appropriate audio when it benefits the
  film. Reuse the demo track only when it suits the actual story, mood and timing;
  it is an option, not the default for every adaptation.
- Fit the visuals and audio to the requested film duration, not to the demo's
  duration. For example, a 15-second brief stays 15 seconds even when the demo
  score is 20 seconds. Edit the selected track with a deliberate ending/fade;
  use the same edited local file in HTML and MP4. For a longer film, arrange or
  replace the track to cover the intended beats rather than leaving an accidental
  silent tail. Do not rely on an HTML-only loop or playbackRate for export.

For background music keep `id="soundtrack"`, `data-start="0"` and a numeric
`data-volume`; update `src` and `data-duration` to the actual edited asset and
film. Remove unused demo audio from the generated composition. Set the source's
`od-motion-audio` metadata to `required` when sound is intended, or `silent` for

Verify the ending and audio in both HTML playback and the exported MP4.

从 `example.html` 开始制作影片，保留本地资源的相对路径。

必须携带 `assets/gsap.min.js`、`assets/engraving.js`、`assets/fish-line.png`、`assets/fish-scale.png`、`assets/fish-fine.png`、`assets/Geist-400.ttf`、`assets/Geist-OFL.txt`、`references/sound.json`。`assets/cover.jpg` 是重建画面的封面。音频由任务运行器按原片情况处理；本次 ffprobe 实测原片没有音轨，未创建音频标签。

  it is an option, not the default for every adaptation.
- Fit the visuals and audio to the requested film duration, not to the demo's
  duration. For example, a 15-second brief stays 15 seconds even when the demo
  score is 20 seconds. Edit the selected track with a deliberate ending/fade;
  use the same edited local file in HTML and MP4. For a longer film, arrange or
  replace the track to cover the intended beats rather than leaving an accidental
  silent tail. Do not rely on an HTML-only loop or playbackRate for export.

For background music keep `id="soundtrack"`, `data-start="0"` and a numeric
`data-volume`; update `src` and `data-duration` to the actual edited asset and
film. Remove unused demo audio from the generated composition. Set the source's
`od-motion-audio` metadata to `required` when sound is intended, or `silent` for
an intentionally silent film, using the general motion-design delivery guidance.
Verify the ending and audio in both HTML playback and the exported MP4.

The `<audio>` element stays inside the composition root; the desktop exporter
mixes its local file into the MP4. Preview sound starts with the film; when the
browser blocks autoplay, the first click or key press turns it on, and Sound off
mutes it. Sound follows the master timeline, including pause and backward
seeks. Keep it silent during frame capture and in sandboxed gallery thumbnails.

When the film length changes, refit or replace the track using references/sound.json (bpm, sections).
To refit, cut the track at the original scene boundaries, time-stretch each piece to its new scene length with ffmpeg atempo (keep each factor within 0.8–1.25; beyond that, trim or loop that piece instead), join the pieces with 40 ms crossfades, fade in 0.15 s and out over the last second, and replace assets/soundtrack.mp3 with the result at exactly CFG.duration.

上述英文为按任务要求保留的官方音频规则；本参考没有音轨，故“示例音轨”说明只在运行器实际提供该资源时适用。

## 来源
@akella：https://x.com/akella/status/2107764940954091531 。仅记录归属，未抓取来源页面。此模板根据本地 `reference.mp4` 重建。

name: superx-audience-growth

content:
---
name: superx-audience-growth
description: "SuperX 受众增长产品宣传模板：火焰点燃品牌，产品操作连续转为增长数据。"
od:
  mode: video
  scenario: video
---

从 `example.html` 开始改编，它是本模板的完整影片。保留单画布、GSAP 主时间轴与纯时间函数 `render(t)`；默认内容完整保留 SuperX 原片身份。

**Arc:** 发布循环 → 品牌点燃 → 发现热门 → 内容写作 → 智能排期 → 互动增长 → 规模数据 → 行动收尾

## 参考文件

复制 `example.html`、`references/sound.json`，以及下列本地资源，保持路径：
- `assets/InstrumentSerif-400-Italic.ttf`
- `assets/InstrumentSerif-OFL.txt`
- `assets/Inter-400.ttf`
- `assets/Inter-500.ttf`
- `assets/Inter-600.ttf`
- `assets/Inter-700.ttf`
- `assets/Inter-OFL.txt`
- `assets/eli-post.png`
- `assets/x-mark.png`
- `assets/cover.jpg`
- `assets/gsap.min.js`
- `assets/mara-avatar.png`
- `assets/mara-post.png`
- `assets/nora-post.png`
- `assets/sam-post.png`
- `assets/superx-flame.png`

`assets/soundtrack.mp3` 是 runner 在交付后加入的演示音轨，是否复制它遵循下方 Sound 说明。字体许可证必须与字体一起保留。外部脚本与字体均不依赖 CDN。

## 结构与节奏

| 场景（CFG.scenes id） | 默认时长 | 画面与意义 | 实现与 cue | 可复用值 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `loop` | 1.883 s | 发布循环，点赞仍然稀少 | 大字弹入、卡片轻微漂移；post-word / hope-word / refresh-word / repeat-word / loop-out；expo.out / cubic.out | `postCopy` |
| `brand` | 1.817 s | 火焰点燃，逐字出现 SuperX | 裁切的火焰标识、粒子爆发、文字揭示；flame-ignites / wordmark-in / brand-out；expo.out / cubic.out | `brand / logoAsset` |
| `fire-wipe` | 0.200 s | 金色扩张圆露出内容墙 | 圆形遮罩与红色光晕；fire-expands；expo.out / cubic.out | `wallNoraAsset / wallSamAsset / wallEliAsset / wallPostAsset` |
| `discover` | 1.750 s | Mara Kent 的热门帖子浮到前景 | 红框卡片透视进入、缓慢落定、逐词主张与浏览量增长；wall-opens / viral-card / discover-line / discover-out；expo.out / cubic.out | `viralCopy / viralLine / viralAccent / avatarAsset` |
| `write` | 1.950 s | 编辑器逐字写入草稿 | 活文字卡片透视翻转、逐字输入、闪烁光标与旋转加载圈；draft-card / draft-typing / write-line / write-out；expo.out / cubic.out | `draftCopy / writeLine / writeAccent` |
| `schedule` | 1.900 s | 每周日历填入时间槽 | 逐格填入、独立时针、日历倾斜；calendar-in / slots-fill / schedule-line / calendar-tilt；expo.out / cubic.out | `scheduleLine / scheduleAccent` |
| `growth` | 1.700 s | 同一日历转成红色柱状图 | 同一投影平面、柱体错峰过冲回落、头像带残影沿弧线入场、绿色环扩散；bars-rise / growth-line / audience-orbits / growth-out；expo.out / cubic.out | `growthLine / accentWord` |
| `proof-flash` | 0.150 s | 浅金闪光连接到数据页 | 径向高光叠加；proof-burst；expo.out / cubic.out | `primary` |
| `metrics` | 1.783 s | 三行规模数据依次滚入 | 逐位数字滚轮、扩张同心环、火花、收缩旋转退场；creators-in / posts-in / impressions-in / metrics-out；expo.out / cubic.out | `creators / posts / impressions` |
| `close` | 1.928 s | 品牌、主张、按钮和网址收尾 | 字标揭示、按钮扫光、持续火花；close-brand / close-tagline / close-cta / close-settle；expo.out / cubic.out | `brand / tagline / accentWord / cta / domain / logoAsset / platformAsset` |

## Adapting the template

所有进场时间均为场景开始后的绝对秒数，所有退场和跨场过渡都读取 `from: "end"` cue。只修改 `CFG.scenes[].dur` 后自动累计起点，并将各段时长之和写回 `CFG.duration`。不按比例缩放场景内部动作。按变量声明中的 maxLength 缩短超长文案，不把字号缩至不可读。

- `loop`：1.883333–3.0 s，可替换 `postCopy`（75字符）与发布困境；保留四个大字节拍和点赞增长。增加时长时延长第四字后的卡片漂移与点阵烟云，不能固定一帧。帖文只有一张，多条内容选最强的一条，少于一条时改写为用户的一个痛点。
- `brand`：1.816667–2.6 s，可替换 `brand`（14字符）和 `logoAsset`；保留中心点燃后标识左移、字标揭示的动作。额外时间由火花与火光呼吸填充。只用一个主品牌，多品牌选择主办方，其余移到收尾说明；缺少标识时重建用户品牌的简单几何记号。
- `fire-wipe`：0.2–0.2 s，锁定。保留金色圆扩张后穿入帖子墙的转场，不加入文字或额外商品。无数量和文案限制；可替换墙面帖子图像，不能使用完整参考帧。
- `discover`：1.75–3.0 s，`viralCopy` 上限110字符，`viralLine` 35字符、`viralAccent` 12字符。保留一张帖子从墙中突出、红边发亮、浏览量上升。额外时间让背景帖子墙继续横移与分层纵移、深度轻微变化，前景卡片缓慢落定；退场的竖轴翻转跨入 `write`，保留两面连续性。更多内容仍只突出最强一条，余下可放在墙面；更少时保留一张真实案例。
- `write`：1.95–3.0 s，`draftCopy` 上限120字符、`writeLine` 24字符、`writeAccent` 24字符。保留热门帖子翻到编辑器的连续透视动作，以及稍后开始的草稿逐字出现与红色光标；延长时间时加载圈持续旋转、光标闪烁、内容墙漂移。只显示一份草稿，多份选择最具代表性的一份，不缩小编辑器。
- `schedule`：1.9–3.0 s，`scheduleLine` 上限40字符、`scheduleAccent` 14字符。保留7列4行日历、排期卡片错峰入场与时钟；延长时间依靠明显的指针转动和烟云。更多排期填空格，超过28项选核心时段；更少则留空格，保持周结构。`calendar-tilt` 从末端倒数，必须与后段投影连续。
- `growth`：1.7–2.8 s，`growthLine` 上限30字符、`accentWord` 12字符。保留日历平面变成七根错峰升高并过冲回落的柱体、随位置倾斜的暖色顶面，以及六头像沿独立弧线带残影入场和绿色环扩散。额外时间用柱顶轻微呼吸、头像环绕和高光移动填充；更多数据取7个代表点，更少插入合理的空位并重新计算列宽，不能虚构用户数据。
- `proof-flash`：0.15–0.15 s，锁定。无文案，保留暖金闪光；只有一个过渡，不受条目数量影响。
- `metrics`：1.783333–2.8 s，`creators` 上限8字符、`posts` 5字符、`impressions` 4字符。保留三行白色数字的逐位滚轮、静止红色单位与扩张暖色同心环；额外时间让背景烟云和微粒持续明显移动。超过三项只取最强三项，少于三项按实际数量垂直居中，禁止保留不属于用户的数字。
- `close`：1.928–3.0 s，`brand` 上限14字符、`tagline` 30字符、`accentWord` 12字符、`cta` 22字符、`domain` 28字符。保留上方品牌、中间主张、下方红色按钮与网址；`platformAsset` 是主张中的 X 平台标识，改编时换成用户平台标识或移除。额外时间让按钮高光、火花、光晕继续运动。只有一个行动目标；多个目标选主目标，缺少网址可移除该行。

总时长变化先由 `discover`、`write`、`schedule`、`growth`、`metrics` 和 `close` 吸收，再扩展 `loop`、`brand`；两段闪光始终锁定。超过范围时重排内容并更新场景表和音轨，不能把固定动作整体减速。

非 Latin / Chinese 文案：`--od-font-heading` 与 `--od-font-body` 均使用已打包的 Inter，后接同字重 Noto Sans SC；`--od-font-accent` 使用 Instrument Serif Italic，后接 Noto Serif SC。简体中文斜体不做伪造；繁体改为 Noto Sans TC / Noto Serif TC。交付前以用户真实的中英混排和标点渲染检查缺字与方框；若机器缺少中文字体，应告知用户。中文字体由 OD 注入，不打包系统字体。

Brand-bound: `brand`、`close` 的 SuperX 标识、品牌、网址和主张都要换成用户的对应内容；`discover`、`write` 的具体人物与帖子、`metrics` 的三组数字必须改为用户有依据的内容；`growth` 的头像缩写应换成用户自己的身份，不能把原片的人物、措辞、主张或数字带进改编片。若删去某项，将时间优先分给 `schedule` 与 `close`，保留相同表现形式。

## 预览与导出

唯一时钟为 `window.__timelines.main`。`window.__odRenderAt(t)` 会暂停、定位并直接重画，支持任意顺序跳转。字体与图像加载完成并等待两个动画帧后才暴露时间轴。预览保留 PLAY / PAUSE、进度条与时间；`html.od-export` 隐藏控制栏并把画布对齐输出原点并填满交付视口；不要恢复固定1920像素的导出CSS宽度，以免较小分辨率裁切。所有可指认的 Canvas 内容由 CFG 变量、场景 id 与 cue id 定位。

## Sound
The demo track is the reference film's own soundtrack.
`assets/soundtrack.mp3` ships as the demo track.
The bundled track is demo material, not a requirement for generated films.
The user's current brief takes priority over this reference and its seed prompt,
including duration, music choice, genre, mood, voiceover and sound effects.
Follow the general motion-design audio guidance; this template does not disable
available audio tools or original audio synthesis.

- If the user requests a silent film, remove all audio. If they request only
  no background music, remove the music but retain any requested sound effects
  or voiceover. No voiceover does not mean no music.
- Use the user's supplied audio when requested. If they request different music,
  choose or create a suitable real local asset using the available audio tools,
  licensed sources or original synthesis. Do not silently substitute the demo
  track for an unmet request; briefly disclose any limitation.
- Without a specific music request, add appropriate audio when it benefits the
  film. Reuse the demo track only when it suits the actual story, mood and timing;
  it is an option, not the default for every adaptation.
- Fit the visuals and audio to the requested film duration, not to the demo's
  duration. For example, a 15-second brief stays 15 seconds even when the demo
  score is 20 seconds. Edit the selected track with a deliberate ending/fade;
  use the same edited local file in HTML and MP4. For a longer film, arrange or
  replace the track to cover the intended beats rather than leaving an accidental
  silent tail. Do not rely on an HTML-only loop or playbackRate for export.

For background music keep `id="soundtrack"`, `data-start="0"` and a numeric
`data-volume`; update `src` and `data-duration` to the actual edited asset and
film. Remove unused demo audio from the generated composition. Set the source's
`od-motion-audio` metadata to `required` when sound is intended, or `silent` for
an intentionally silent film, using the general motion-design delivery guidance.
Verify the ending and audio in both HTML playback and the exported MP4.

The `<audio>` element stays inside the composition root; the desktop exporter
mixes its local file into the MP4. Preview sound starts with the film; when the
browser blocks autoplay, the first click or key press turns it on, and Sound off
mutes it. Sound follows the master timeline, including pause and backward
seeks. Keep it silent during frame capture and in sandboxed gallery thumbnails.

When the film length changes, refit or replace the track using references/sound.json (bpm, sections).
To refit, cut the track at the original scene boundaries, time-stretch each piece to its new scene length with ffmpeg atempo (keep each factor within 0.8–1.25; beyond that, trim or loop that piece instead), join the pieces with 40 ms crossfades, fade in 0.15 s and out over the last second, and replace assets/soundtrack.mp3 with the result at exactly CFG.duration.

## 来源

原片作者：@robj3d3。署名链接：https://x.com/robj3d3/status/2103875898349088830 。只使用本地 `reference.mp4` 分析，未访问来源帖子。火焰和静态帖子从局部画面裁切；动态产品操作、字标、文字和背景由代码重建。

name: motion-tixfox-ticket-promo
content:
# TixFox 票务宣传片

从 `example.html` 开始制作；此文件是完整画面与唯一时间逻辑入口。

**Arc:** 提问 → 费用问题 → 品牌 → 定价 → 建活动与销售 → 购票 → 收款 → 检票 → 品牌收尾

## 文件
保留 `assets/gsap.min.js`、`assets/Roboto-regular.ttf`、`assets/Roboto-OFL.txt`、`assets/fox-logo.png`、`assets/fox-coin.png`、`assets/microphone.png`、`assets/ticket-qr.png`、`assets/fox-tickets.png`、`assets/RobotoMono-regular.ttf`、`assets/RobotoMono-OFL.txt` 和 `references/sound.json` 的相对路径。配乐文件为 `assets/soundtrack.mp3`，由运行器补入。

## 场景
| Scene (`CFG.scenes` id) | Dur | Summary | Build | Reuse |
|-|-|-|-|-|
| `hook` | 3.8 s | 开场提问 | 单 canvas，纯时间函数，文字 power3.out，入场及尾部 cue | 读取 CFG 品牌及活动变量，保持左右构图 |
| `problem` | 2.65 s | 费用侵蚀票款 | 单 canvas，纯时间函数，文字 power3.out，入场及尾部 cue | 读取 CFG 品牌及活动变量，保持左右构图 |
| `meet` | 1.95 s | 认识 TixFox | 单 canvas，纯时间函数，文字 power3.out，入场及尾部 cue | 读取 CFG 品牌及活动变量，保持左右构图 |
| `pricing` | 5.05 s | 39¢ 定价与零固定费 | 单 canvas，纯时间函数，文字 power3.out，入场及尾部 cue | 读取 CFG 品牌及活动变量，保持左右构图 |
| `make` | 5.9 s | 创建、分享及实时销售 | 单 canvas，纯时间函数，文字 power3.out，入场及尾部 cue | 读取 CFG 品牌及活动变量，保持左右构图 |
| `checkout` | 4.3 s | 三次点击与二维码 | 单 canvas，纯时间函数，文字 power3.out，入场及尾部 cue | 读取 CFG 品牌及活动变量，保持左右构图 |
| `paid` | 4.3 s | 即时转入银行 | 单 canvas，纯时间函数，文字 power3.out，入场及尾部 cue | 读取 CFG 品牌及活动变量，保持左右构图 |
| `scan` | 3.65 s | 手机检票 | 单 canvas，纯时间函数，文字 power3.out，入场及尾部 cue | 读取 CFG 品牌及活动变量，保持左右构图 |
| `close` | 6.94933 s | 品牌及行动入口 | 单 canvas，纯时间函数，文字 power3.out，入场及尾部 cue | 读取 CFG 品牌及活动变量，保持左右构图 |

## Adapting the template
- `hook`：开场提问。可替换对应品牌、活动与界面文字，保持原来的逐行揭示、橙色强调及左右构图；伸缩范围 3.8–5.7 秒，未锁定。新增时间由狐狸呼吸、眨眼、卡片浮动或硬币旋转填充，退出必须读 end cue。品牌上限 12、网址 24、费用 7、活动名称 28 字符；超出先改短文案，不缩到难以阅读。产品种类多于四类时选最有代表性的四类，少于四类则居中分布，其他界面仍保留一个主活动。
- `problem`：费用侵蚀票款。可替换对应品牌、活动与界面文字，保持原来的逐行揭示、橙色强调及左右构图；伸缩范围 2.65–4 秒，未锁定。新增时间由狐狸呼吸、眨眼、卡片浮动或硬币旋转填充，退出必须读 end cue。品牌上限 12、网址 24、费用 7、活动名称 28 字符；超出先改短文案，不缩到难以阅读。产品种类多于四类时选最有代表性的四类，少于四类则居中分布，其他界面仍保留一个主活动。
- `meet`：认识 TixFox。可替换对应品牌、活动与界面文字，保持原来的逐行揭示、橙色强调及左右构图；伸缩范围 1.95–2.9 秒，未锁定。新增时间由狐狸呼吸、眨眼、卡片浮动或硬币旋转填充，退出必须读 end cue。品牌上限 12、网址 24、费用 7、活动名称 28 字符；超出先改短文案，不缩到难以阅读。产品种类多于四类时选最有代表性的四类，少于四类则居中分布，其他界面仍保留一个主活动。
- `pricing`：39¢ 定价与零固定费。可替换对应品牌、活动与界面文字，保持原来的逐行揭示、橙色强调及左右构图；伸缩范围 5.05–7.5 秒，未锁定。新增时间由狐狸呼吸、眨眼、卡片浮动或硬币旋转填充，退出必须读 end cue。品牌上限 12、网址 24、费用 7、活动名称 28 字符；超出先改短文案，不缩到难以阅读。产品种类多于四类时选最有代表性的四类，少于四类则居中分布，其他界面仍保留一个主活动。
- `make`：创建、分享及实时销售。可替换对应品牌、活动与界面文字，保持原来的逐行揭示、橙色强调及左右构图；伸缩范围 5.9–8.8 秒，未锁定。新增时间由狐狸呼吸、眨眼、卡片浮动或硬币旋转填充，退出必须读 end cue。品牌上限 12、网址 24、费用 7、活动名称 28 字符；超出先改短文案，不缩到难以阅读。产品种类多于四类时选最有代表性的四类，少于四类则居中分布，其他界面仍保留一个主活动。

## Sound
The bundled track is demo material, not a requirement for generated films.
The user's current brief takes priority over this reference and its seed prompt,
including duration, music choice, genre, mood, voiceover and sound effects.
Follow the general motion-design audio guidance; this template does not disable
available audio tools or original audio synthesis.

- If the user requests a silent film, remove all audio. If they request only
  no background music, remove the music but retain any requested sound effects
  or voiceover. No voiceover does not mean no music.
- Use the user's supplied audio when requested. If they request different music,
  choose or create a suitable real local asset using the available audio tools,
  licensed sources or original synthesis. Do not silently substitute the demo
  track for an unmet request; briefly disclose any limitation.
- Without a specific music request, add appropriate audio when it benefits the
  film. Reuse the demo track only when it suits the actual story, mood and timing;
  it is an option, not the default for every adaptation.
- Fit the visuals and audio to the requested film duration, not to the demo's
  duration. For example, a 15-second brief stays 15 seconds even when the demo
  score is 20 seconds. Edit the selected track with a deliberate ending/fade;
  use the same edited local file in HTML and MP4. For a longer film, arrange or
  replace the track to cover the intended beats rather than leaving an accidental
  silent tail. Do not rely on an HTML-only loop or playbackRate for export.

For background music keep `id="soundtrack"`, `data-start="0"` and a numeric
`data-volume`; update `src` and `data-duration` to the actual edited asset and
film. Remove unused demo audio from the generated composition. Set the source's
`od-motion-audio` metadata to `required` when sound is intended, or `silent` for
an intentionally silent film, using the general motion-design delivery guidance.
Verify the ending and audio in both HTML playback and the exported MP4.

The `<audio>` element stays inside the composition root; the desktop exporter
mixes its local file into the MP4. Preview sound starts with the film; when the
browser blocks autoplay, the first click or key press turns it on, and Sound off
mutes it. Sound follows the master timeline, including pause and backward
seeks. Keep it silent during frame capture and in sandboxed gallery thumbnails.

The demo track is the reference film's own soundtrack.
When the film length changes, refit or replace the track using references/sound.json (bpm, sections).
To refit, cut the track at the original scene boundaries, time-stretch each piece to its new scene length with ffmpeg atempo (keep each factor within 0.8–1.25; beyond that, trim or loop that piece instead), join the pieces with 40 ms crossfades, fade in 0.15 s and out over the last second, and replace assets/soundtrack.mp3 with the result at exactly CFG.duration.

## 来源
原片由 @achxvi 发布：https://x.com/achxvi/status/2108212570096038173 。仅使用本地提供的 reference.mp4 分析，未获取来源网页。

# One-Shape UI Motion

A 14-second code-only UI motion piece, rebuilt from the viral original: one shape morphs from a button into a loader, player, slider, toggle, tabs, chart, command palette and toast, driven by a cursor at 120 BPM. `example.html` is the finished reference — start from it.

The reference timing and beat map describe the demo. Adapt them to the user's
requested duration and content; do not force the reference duration or music.

## Source
A remake of a viral post by @twoclipping: https://x.com/twoclipping/status/2103273003555402193 (1.03M views · 12K likes · 20K bookmarks on X (as of 2026-10-05)). The composition is
rebuilt in code from the published piece; the soundtrack is original.

## Reference files
Copy `example.html`, `assets/geist-OFL.txt`, `assets/geist-medium.ttf`, `assets/geist-regular.ttf`, `assets/geist-semibold.ttf`, `assets/gsap.min.js` into the composition, preserving the `assets/` path.
Copy the demo soundtrack only if selected under the Sound guidance below.
Font licenses travel with their fonts. Use these frozen local bytes; no runtime
script or font CDN is needed.

## Art direction
- Warm light-gray canvas `#EDEDE8`, black `#0A0A0A` and white components, toggle track `#D0D1CA`; one soft drop shadow.
- Font (SIL OFL, bundled): Geist Regular, Medium and SemiBold.
- The original is a 1440×1440 square; this reference keeps its scale on a 1920×1080 stage.

## Beat map (14s)
- 120 BPM, 7 bars: Generate button → loader → check → dynamic island → music player (play/pause morph, scrub) → volume slider that stretches past max → toggle → liquid tab indicator → chart that draws itself with a hover tooltip and a Week switch → ⌘K palette (type "frame", enter) → toast → Generate button.
- The last frame matches the first, so it loops.

## Adapting the template
- Replace the UI states in `SHAPE` and their contents; keep one shape that never cuts, springs summed per change, and a cursor that causes every change.

## How the reference is built
- One composition root with canvas layers. A single `render(t)` draws the
  whole frame from the master timeline time `t`; constants at the top hold copy,
  palette and timing so the film can be re-themed in one place.
- Every visible value is a pure function of `t` (eases, springs or keyframes
  evaluated from time). No state carries between frames.

## Preview and video export
Keep the stage edge to edge in both gallery and MP4 capture. Playback controls
are an overlay that stays transparent until hovered or focused; never reserve
stage space for them or include them in the poster. Inside an Open Design
project the motion source player fits the stage and owns the controls, so the
preview shell yields its own fit and controls there.

The GSAP master timeline is the only clock. Render every visible layer from
its current time in the per-frame loop: export seeks suppress timeline
callbacks. Schedule the next animation frame before drawing so one failed
frame cannot stop the loop. Backward seeks must reproduce identical frames.
Await bundled fonts before playback and signal preview-ready at a legible hero
frame. Preserve `window.__timelines` and the composition's timing attributes.
Avoid large canvas gradients and per-pixel noise: they make every captured
frame expensive and slow the MP4 export.

# 让灵感成真 / Bring Ideas to Life

A 20-second paper-cutout story for OpenDesign: a girl sends “OpenDesign, what can you design?” on a paper plane. The buddy demonstrates interactive prototypes, websites, PPT, posters and motion films. The works fold into a book and return to her: “It starts with your idea.” She hugs it, waves thanks, then pins “What will you design?” beside her window as an invitation to the viewer. `example.html` is the editable reference — start from it.

The reference timing and beat map describe the demo. Adapt them to the user's
requested duration and content; do not force the reference duration or music.

## Source
A story adaptation of a viral post by @kevin_t_ngo: https://x.com/kevin_t_ngo/status/2102437977435893771 (665K views · 6.2K likes · 3.0K bookmarks on X (as of 2026-10-13)). The composition is
inspired by the published piece’s paper craft and rebuilt in code; the soundtrack is original. The original is a 28-second square film; this is a 20-second cut framed in 16:9, and its character is the Open Design buddy built from the logo mark.

## Reference files
Copy `example.html`, `assets/gsap.min.js`, `assets/short-stack-OFL.txt`, `assets/short-stack-regular.ttf` into the composition, preserving the `assets/` path.
Copy the demo soundtrack only if selected under the Sound guidance below.
Font licenses travel with their fonts. Use these frozen local bytes; no runtime
script or font CDN is needed.

## Art direction
- Match the reference’s handmade paper craft: uneven torn white fibres, broad directional gouache strokes with dry bristles, and coloured paper layered around the characters. Vary each sheet’s brush angle; avoid a uniform repeated dash pattern or glossy UI styling.
- Night blues `#262D70` / `#30398A`, purple wall `#4A3A8A`, warm yellow window `#F4C443`, pink curtains `#EE8E96`, paper `#FFFCF3`, blue pen `#3B62B5`, red pencil `#D8443A`.
- The girl has a brown bob, yellow clip, separate paper eyes, painted teal sweater and pointed white collar. Head, upper arm, forearm and hand articulate separately; paper texture stays attached to each piece.
- The OpenDesign buddy retains its dark logo tile, white ring and green cursor. Give it short, plump paper mittens with rounded ends, each drawn as one soft piece. Keep shoulder-to-hand reach below one third of its body width; no thin segmented arms or tiny dot hands. Move or tilt the whole buddy toward a prop so the hand really touches it: lean in to tap, float beside the tape, and tuck behind the book to hold it close.
- Use Short Stack (SIL OFL, bundled) for English hand lettering. Preserve the source’s intimate central composition while extending walls and sky into 16:9.
- Give each capability a recognisable designed output and its own action. Use object-led cuts, hinges, creases, hand contact and overlap, with short anticipation and a readable hold.
- Keep capability labels clear of the buddy throughout each entrance and action. Give the prototype tap and PPT page turn enough time for both the action and its result to read.
- Start the collecting book with empty page slots. Move the five works into their own slots one at a time; each thumbnail appears only when its work lands. Close the cover after all five have arrived.
- Keep the reply physically continuous through its fold, flight and opening. The girl catches it at chest height with both hands; the incoming book must leave her eyes and expression visible.
- Make the final lined invitation note large enough to read at gallery-preview size. Raise and pin it beside the girl, keep her hand in contact until release, then hold the complete “What will you design?” while she brings her hands together. This is the audience's question.

## Beat map (20s)
- 0–1s: establish the night town and the girl at her window.
- 1–1.5s: she gets an idea and raises her pencil.
- 1.5–3.5s: she writes “OpenDesign, what can you design?” and holds the complete question.
- 3.5–4.25s: she folds the corners and wings of the paper plane.
- 4.25–4.75s: she throws the plane from her window.
- 4.75–5.5s: the plane crosses the night sky and reaches the buddy.
- 5.5–7s: the buddy reads, thinks and responds with a spark.
- 7–8.5s: an interactive prototype changes pages after a tap; hold the changed page.
- 8.5–9.5s: a paper website unfolds its hero and content blocks.
- 9.5–11s: a PPT cover turns to a chart slide; bars rise in sequence and settle.
- 11–12s: illustrated posters overlap; the buddy tapes one into place.
- 12–13s: a plane flies across a filmstrip while its timeline advances.
- 13–14.1s: the five works land one by one in the book's empty page slots; its cover then folds shut.
- 14.1–14.8s: the closed book folds into the reply and travels back through the night sky.
- 14.8–15.6s: the girl catches the book at her chest with both hands, leaving her face visible, and opens it.
- 15.6–17s: the open book shows all five works, with “It starts with your idea.” and a hand-drawn circle.
- 17–17.75s: close-up of the girl hugging the book, with a closed-eye smile.
- 17.75–18.5s: back in the town, she holds the book and waves to the buddy.
- 18.5–20s: she raises and pins a large, legible lined note beside the window, then brings her hands together. Hold on “What will you design?” with “you” circled. This is an invitation to the viewer, after the buddy has answered her question.

## Adapting the template
- Edit `CFG.question` (three lines), `CFG.answer`, `CFG.invitation` (three lines), `LIST` (labels), `S` (the five miniature renderers) and `PALETTE` together. Maintain the handwritten question’s safe margins.
- Preserve the reference's reaction, thank-you and pinned-note closing gestures. Keep the audience invitation on the physical note instead of a floating town banner.
- Keep each demonstration’s actual action and the same works in the closing book. A capability should be visible as a designed result.
- Choose and time audio for the current brief using the Sound guidance below.

## How the reference is built

  palette and timing so the film can be re-themed in one place.

  evaluated from time). No state carries between frames.
- Textures (brush, grain, newsprint, handwriting, knit) and every cut-paper
  backdrop and card sheet are painted once into offscreen canvases at load;
  each frame only composites them and draws the few moving parts.

## Preview and video export

Avoid large canvas gradients and per-pixel noise: they make every captured

  use the same edited local file in HTML and MP4. For a longer film, arrange or

## Sound
The demo track is the reference film's own soundtrack.
When the film length changes, refit or replace the track using references/sound.json (bpm, sections).
The bundled track is demo material, not a requirement for generated films.
The user's current brief takes priority over this reference and its seed prompt,
including duration, music choice, genre, mood, voiceover and sound effects.
Follow the general motion-design audio guidance; this template does not disable
available audio tools or original audio synthesis.

- If the user requests a silent film, remove all audio. If they request only
  no background music, remove the music but retain any requested sound effects
  or voiceover. No voiceover does not mean no music.
- Use the user's supplied audio when requested. If they request different music,
  choose or create a suitable real local asset using the available audio tools,
  licensed sources or original synthesis. Do not silently substitute the demo
  track for an unmet request; briefly disclose any limitation.
- Without a specific music request, add appropriate audio when it benefits the
  film. Reuse the demo track only when it suits the actual story, mood and timing;
  it is an option, not the default for every adaptation.
- Fit the visuals and audio to the requested film duration, not to the demo's
  duration. For example, a 15-second brief stays 15 seconds even when the demo
  score is 20 seconds. Edit the selected track with a deliberate ending/fade;
  use the same edited local file in HTML and MP4. For a longer film, arrange or
  replace the track to cover the intended beats rather than leaving an accidental
  silent tail. Do not rely on an HTML-only loop or playbackRate for export.

For background music keep `id="soundtrack"`, `data-start="0"` and a numeric
`data-volume`; update `src` and `data-duration` to the actual edited asset and
film. Remove unused demo audio from the generated composition. Set the source's
`od-motion-audio` metadata to `required` when sound is intended, or `silent` for
an intentionally silent film, using the general motion-design delivery guidance.
Verify the ending and audio in both HTML playback and the exported MP4.

The `<audio>` element stays inside the composition root; the desktop exporter
mixes its local file into the MP4. Preview sound starts with the film; when the
browser blocks autoplay, the first click or key press turns it on, and Sound off
mutes it. Sound follows the master timeline, including pause and backward
seeks. Keep it silent during frame capture and in sandboxed gallery thumbnails.

# Contribute Plugin to OpenDesign

Use this workflow when the active project contains a copied plugin folder and the user wants to propose it for the OpenDesign community catalog.

## Workflow

1. Read the active plugin inputs. `plugin_context_path` is the copied plugin folder relative to the project working directory.
2. Inspect the copied plugin's manifest, skill instructions, examples, and compatibility metadata.
3. Call the local daemon endpoint instead of hand-rolling GitHub commands:
   `curl -sS -X POST "$OD_DAEMON_URL/api/projects/$OD_PROJECT_ID/plugins/contribute-open-design" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"path":"<plugin_context_path>"}'`
4. Read the JSON response. If `ok` is true, report the PR URL, branch name when present in the log, and any useful validation summary.
5. If the endpoint fails, report its `message`, `code`, and useful log lines. When authentication is missing, tell the user to run `gh auth login --hostname github.com`.

Keep the pull request focused. Do not modify unrelated OpenDesign files unless a manifest validation issue requires a tiny supporting change.

# Publish Plugin to GitHub

Use this workflow when the active project contains a copied plugin folder and the user wants it published as a new public GitHub repository.

## Workflow

1. Read the active plugin inputs. `plugin_context_path` is the copied plugin folder relative to the project working directory.
2. Inspect `open-design.json`, `SKILL.md`, and any compatibility metadata in the copied folder.
3. Call the local daemon endpoint instead of hand-rolling GitHub commands:
   `curl -sS -X POST "$OD_DAEMON_URL/api/projects/$OD_PROJECT_ID/plugins/publish-github" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"path":"<plugin_context_path>"}'`
4. Read the JSON response. If `ok` is true, report the final repository URL and any useful log/validation summary.
5. If the endpoint fails, report its `message`, `code`, and useful log lines. When authentication is missing, tell the user to run `gh auth login --hostname github.com`.

Prefer the manifest `name` as the repository slug. If that repository already exists, choose the next clear slug and mention the rename.

name: open-design-homepage
title: OpenDesign Homepage
description: A pixel-faithful, self-contained mirror of the live open-design.ai homepage — an interactive React Three Fiber / Next.js hero with a real-time 3D wordmark, sticker collage, variable fonts, and scroll-driven motion. First-party showcase of the visual ceiling for interactive web marketing surfaces.

# OpenDesign Homepage

A first-party **showcase** template that mirrors the live [open-design.ai](https://open-design.ai) homepage, captured as a fully self-contained bundle that renders in the sandboxed preview.

It is here to demonstrate the **visual ceiling** OpenDesign targets for interactive, WebGL-grade marketing surfaces on the web — not a fill-in-the-blank generator. Treat it as a reference build to study and adapt.

## What it is

- **Interactive 3D hero** — a real-time `OpenDesign` script wordmark rendered with **React Three Fiber / Three.js**, plus a cursor-reactive parallax layer and a floating sticker collage.
- **Scroll-driven narrative** — the work grid, capabilities copy, and decorative stickers animate as the page scrolls.
- **Craft details** — custom variable fonts (TikTok Sans, Geist Mono, Departure Mono), a light/dark theme toggle, an optional ambient soundtrack, and a live clock / cursor-coordinate HUD.

## How it is built (for reference)

- **Stack**: Next.js (App Router, Turbopack build) + React Three Fiber + Three.js, exported as a static, self-contained bundle.
- **3D geometry** is **Draco-compressed** (`KHR_draco_mesh_compression`) — the hero wordmark drops from ~4.4 MB to ~300 KB with no visible change, decoded at runtime by the bundled `DRACOLoader`.
- **Imagery** (work thumbnails, stickers) ships as **lossless WebP** — pixel-identical to the source PNGs at a fraction of the size, so every file stays under the 1 MB repository blob limit and the template needs no external asset host.
- **Self-contained & path-portable**: all assets load relative to the entry file, so the bundle renders correctly whether served from the site root or a nested preview subpath.

The exported Turbopack loader normalizes each registered script URL against
`document.baseURI` before identifying its chunk. Preserve that compatibility
change when refreshing the export: sandbox preview hosts can rewrite script
attributes to absolute URLs with workspace query parameters. Comparing those
attributes directly with the relative `./assets/_next/` prefix leaves bootstrap
dependencies unresolved and the page stuck on its loading bar. Keep query
parameters on requests; only normalize chunk identity. Normalize pending-load
keys too, because Flight hydration asks for relative, unscoped chunk URLs.

The exported router keeps the serialized homepage path when its location is
`about:srcdoc`, and uses `document.baseURI` to resolve router/prefetch URLs.
Otherwise the opaque iframe URL either throws or selects a nonexistent route.
The plugin asset route permits opaque-origin reads only for declared assets
of bundled plugins, allowing WebGL textures, model fetches and fonts to load
without adding `allow-same-origin` to the preview sandbox.

## Using it

Open `example.html` in the preview to explore the live, interactive result. All content is bundled locally — fonts, imagery, and 3D geometry ship in `assets/`, so there are no CDN scripts or external fonts. The one runtime network request is the Draco decoder, fetched from Google's `gstatic` CDN on demand (the same pattern the other WebGL examples use for their libraries). To adapt the aesthetic (typography, 3D treatment, sticker collage, scroll motion) into your own build, study the structure here and recreate it with your preferred React Three Fiber / Next.js setup.
